entities.summary: Gaero was the 21st king of Baekje, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea. He was the eldest son of the 20th king Biyu. He died on Achasan as Baekje's capital in the present-day Pungnaptoseong region fell to the northern rival kingdom Goguryeo.
